title: Recover from an uninitialized Windows transparent-mode resolver connection
answers: Transparent mode raises AttributeError before connecting to the upstream host
Windows original-destination lookup fails because wfile is missing
How should the Windows resolver recover before its first connection?
body:
Symptom: Transparent mode raises AttributeError when resolving the original destination before the upstream connection has been established.
Root cause: mitmproxy/platform/windows.py:Resolver.original_addr writes to self.wfile before it has been initialized.
Fix pattern: Include AttributeError alongside EOFError and OSError in the lookup's recovery handler; call Resolver._connect to initialize wfile, then retry original_addr.
Constraints: This recovery applies to the Windows resolver's original-destination lookup with an uninitialized connection; it does not establish a general policy for catching AttributeError elsewhere.
applies: Windows transparent-mode original-destination resolution in Resolver.original_addr.
